paper_title: MADLLM Multivariate Anomaly Detection via Pre-trained LLMs
caption: : (a) The impact of hyperparameter N on F1 score. (b) The impact of hyperparameter N on AUC.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the variable "N" and the percentage of AUC, with multiple lines representing different datasets or conditions. The x-axis is labeled "N" and uses a linear scale with values ranging from 0 to 20, marked at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "AUC (%)" and also uses a linear scale, with values ranging from 75 to 100, marked at intervals of 5. A light blue line with circle markers and a solid style starts at approximately (0, 94) and shows a peak at (5, 98) before declining to (20, 94). An orange line with square markers starts at (0, 87), peaking slightly at (10, 98), and ends at (20, 92). A green line with star markers begins at (0, 86), shows a steady increase to (15, 94) and ends at slightly low point to (20,93). A magenta line with inverted triangle markers stays low at the start at around (0, 80), peaks sharply at (10, 96), and declines to (20, 83). A yellow line with square markers starts at (0, 84), rises to a peak at (15, 95), and then slightly decreases to (20, 94).
